title: Add tests for the switch-connection secret annotation and redaction
description: Extend tests/integration/tools/mongodb/connect/connect.test.ts, which already covers switch-connection, and add a unit test under tests/unit/tools. The tests must assert three things: (a) the tools/list inputSchema for switch-connection marks connectionString as secret; (b) after the tool is invoked, the session keychain holds the supplied URI; (c) the error text for a failing switch-connection call with a credential-bearing URI such as mongodb://user:placeholder@127.0.0.1:1 does not include the credential part. Use only placeholder credentials in fixtures, never a real secret.
acceptanceCriteria: `pnpm test` exits 0, and the run lists the new switch-connection secret-annotation and redaction test cases as passed
Reverting only the change from task 1 or task 2 locally makes at least one of the new tests fail, which shows the tests guard the control

verificationMethod.description: A reviewer reads the new test cases and the CI run on the PR. Expected result: the three assertions (schema metadata, keychain registration, redacted error text) are present, all pass in CI, and the fixtures use placeholder credentials only.

rootCause.description: No test asserts secret handling for tool arguments, so the gap between connect/switch-connection and the config-level connectionString went undetected.
